title: Mweya Wakazvipira weMurazvo Mutsvene
intro: Pamberi pako pane nyaya yeushingi hunoshamisa, apo mumwe munhu akashinga kupikisa zvitendero zvakadzika midzi mutsika yose. Tevedzera mashoko aya ekare, uye uchawana hupenyu hwakaratidzwa nekutenda kusingachinji, kupona kunoshamisa, uye kuiswa kwenheyo dzaizoumba rwendo rwemweya rwemabhiriyoni. Tevedzera chiratidzo chimwe nechimwe nokungwarira - moto mutsvene uchiri kurangarira.
clues: Ndakazvarirwa mumhuri yairemekedza mitumbi yekudenga nezvifananidzo zvakavezwa, asi chimwe chinhu chakaramba zvavainamata mukati mangu.

Ndakamira ndichipesana nemutongi ane simba kupfuura vose munyika yangu, ndichiputsa zvifananidzo chaizvo zvainamatwa nevanhu vangu, uye ndichizivisa kuti Musiki wedenga chete ndiye anofanirwa kunamata.
Murazvo wemoto wakatsva wakarairwa muzita rangu, asi ndakazivisa kuti Iye wandaishumira ega ndiye aizondiponesa — uye marimi emoto akarayirwa kuti atonhorere uye akachengeteka.
Ndakasiya zvese zvandaiziva nemurairo waMwari, ndichidzungaira nemumipata yakaoma nemhuri yangu, ndichivimba nechikafu chandakanga ndisati ndaona.
Takamira padivi pemwanakomana wangu wedangwe mumupata usina chinhu, takavaka pamwe chete nheyo dzeimba tsvene, nzvimbo tsvene yakagadzirirwa vose vanozviisa pasi.
Ndinozivikanwa saKhalilullah — shamwari yepedyo yeAne Tsitsi — uye zita rangu rakagara richibatanidzwa nekutenda kwekuzvipira nekuzvipira.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
